top30.abstract: Nature Computational Science, Published online: 13 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s43588-026-01044-3Accurately predicting properties of materials is one of the main challenges in computational materials science. This limitation does not reverse as model or dataset sizes grow.

top30.title: Foundation models unlock robust phenotypic representations from Cell Painting images
top30.abstract: Nature Methods, Published online: 30 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41592-026-03271-yWe pretrained and systematically benchmarked a suite of self-supervised foundation models on the largest public Cell Painting dataset, enabling robust morphological feature extraction directly from multichannel high-content images without cell segmentation or feature engineering. These models outperformed classical methods and demonstrated generalizability across cell types.
